interior_gamma_extension.derivation: Differentiate the Gamma-product logarithm of T. On interior integer points psi(m+1)=H_m-gamma and psi1(m+1)=zeta(2)-H_m^(2); the constants cancel.

lattice_extension.protected_shell_convention: H(m,r)=0 for m<=0 in the protected discrete target
lattice_extension.T_times_Lk: T*Lk_disc=-partial_k T on every integer point of 0<=k,l<=n+3
lattice_extension.T_times_Ll: T*Ll_disc=-partial_l T on every integer point of 0<=k,l<=n+3
lattice_extension.T_times_A: T*A_disc=partial_k partial_l T on every integer point of 0<=k,l<=n+3
lattice_extension.reason: On interior points the identities are the Gamma/digamma formulas. On any moving-support shell T has an exact double zero in each out-of-support coordinate. A single derivative in that coordinate still vanishes at the integer shell, so both sides are zero; the mixed derivative likewise retains at least a simple zero in every shell coordinate.

nested_weight_decomposition.consequence: The nested-coordinate part of E_D is E[A]*N11 + E[Lk]*N12k + E[Ll]*N12l; all finite differences of N11/N12k/N12l are one-body.

regularized_derivative_certificates.derivation: Differentiate the reverified analytic Q-row identity before specializing to the integer lattice. Replace the differentiated kernels by T*Lk_disc, T*Ll_disc, and T*A_disc using the lattice-extension identities. One application of the discrete product rule cancels the F_shift*Delta(f) terms already present in E[f], leaving the displayed pure divergences.

shell_reconciliation.regularized_product_statement: rho_sym*T and sigma_sym*T have removable singularities and therefore holomorphic extensions Fk,Fl across every shell and their intersections. Their first and mixed coordinate derivatives are finite there.
shell_reconciliation.generic_field_simplification_forbidden_o: Do not replace -partial(F)-F*L_disc by -T*partial(rho), or the mixed analogue, at shell points. Such cancellation uses the singular analytic logarithmic derivative rather than the protected discrete L_disc and can manufacture a spurious pole.

historical_cubic_pole_witness.interpretation: This witnesses only that the simplified coefficient derivative is shell-singular; it does not obstruct the unsimplified derivative of the regularized product Fk.

lower_boundary.consequence: Fk and the derivatives needed by Jk vanish at k=0; Fl and the derivatives needed by Jl vanish at l=0. Mixed derivatives retain the coordinate zero.

shell_reconciliation.upper_boundary: At K+1>=n+4 the Q-row coefficients have no moving-support pole. T retains an exact double zero in the exiting coordinate; one derivative leaves at least a simple zero. Hence every regularized differentiated flux above vanishes on the upper finite-box boundary.
shell_reconciliation.joint_shell_intersections: The pole/zero cancellation is coordinatewise of order two, so Fk and Fl extend holomorphically across joint shell intersections; one derivative in each coordinate remains finite.

abel_transfer.principle: For each nested basis element N and exact global coefficient certificate E[f]=Delta_k Jk+Delta_l Jl, finite summation by parts transfers the differences from J onto N. Boundary terms vanish by the reconciled differentiated-flux boundary certificate. Since Delta_k/Delta_l of N11, N12k, and N12l are one-body, the entire nested sector reduces exactly to the one-body sector.
